description: Fixed expectations for independently computed compound-collection facts and input provenance.

expected_claims.chemistry.unique_murcko_scaffolds.defini: Distinct non-null, non-empty Metadata_MurckoScaffold values; acyclic compounds are excluded from the scaffold count
expected_claims.chemistry.pains_flagged.definition: Metadata_HasPAINS is true in the canonical analyzed roster
expected_claims.clinical_development.definition: Separate values of Metadata_repurposing_clinical_phase; preclinical and phase counts are not subsets of the launched count
expected_claims.annotations.target_or_moa.definition: Union of ChEMBL, Repurposing Hub target/MOA, Chemical Probes Portal, and every MOTIVE gene annotation
expected_claims.annotations.target_or_moa.distinct_from_: This paper-facing target/MOA union is not the chemical-space nine-source annotated_any metric
expected_claims.commercial_availability.molport.definiti: Canonical analyzed compounds with an exact-SMILES match in the MolPort quote archive after applying Price, USD <= 200
expected_claims.dual_sourcing.definition: Canonical analyzed compounds associated with at least two distinct Metadata_Compound_Source values; this operationalizes separate partner-provided samples
expected_claims.functional_use.predicted_fup.coverage_se: Endpoint-dependent; missing FUP probabilities are excluded rather than imputed
expected_claims.functional_use.predicted_fup.dominant_cl: argmax over each compound's non-null FUP probabilities
expected_claims.functional_use.interpretation_caveat: Curated FUC and predicted FUP counts can overlap. The leading classes are predicted FUP classes, not curated FUC categories.

functional_use_provenance.pipeline: EPA functional use classification pipeline described by Phillips et al. 2017 (PMID: 30505234)
functional_use_provenance.interpretation_caveat: Curated FUC and predicted FUP counts can overlap. The leading classes are predicted FUP classes, not curated FUC categories.
